# Independent audit: rotated-triangle radial nonincrease obstruction

Audited source:
`candidate 92e51a4b18979d56`.

Result: PASS, with no mathematical correction requested. The independent
stdlib verifier is `supporting computation verify_rotated_triangle_radial_obstruction_functional.py`.

1. Computing the two linear images of the centered standard triangle
gives exactly the displayed A,B vertices. Their determinants are
103/100, so both areas are 103/200. The convex hull of the nine
pairwise endpoint means has exactly the six displayed D vertices
and area 13/20. The middle fiber of the lifted hull is exactly D;
the endpoint bases are exposed. Thus the actual source and its
claimed equality constraint are correct.

2. Independent rational polygon clipping by x>=0 gives cap areas
206/891 in both endpoint triangles and 299/990 in D. Division by
the actual fiber areas gives 400/891 and 46/99 respectively. The
integer matrix R=[[-1,-1],[1,0]] has determinant one, order three,
commutes with J, and preserves all three fibers. It permutes the
cap normals. Hence all three global budgets are exactly 6811/8910,
and their normalized fraction is 4865/10692<1/2. The three K
vertices in D give the required strict witnesses for individual
cap essentiality.

3. The supports at (1,-1) are (9/10,11/10) and at (2,1) are
(11/10,9/10). In both cases the middle support is one. Actual
Minkowski inclusion therefore implies r_0>=a+|b|/10. These are
necessary support inequalities, exactly as stated; sufficiency
of just these two directions is never used.

4. Through-origin radial dilation preserves each fiber's cap
fraction. The decomposition D'_cap=f M'+W(f_0-f)r_0^2 is exact.
Mass nondecrease and cap nonincrease imply r_0<=1. Squaring
a<=r_0-|b|/10 is legitimate because both sides are positive in
the prescribed neighborhood. Expanding gives coefficient 101w/50
on b^2 and the negative cross coefficient 2w/5. The bound
|b|<1/10, r_0>9/10 gives the strict residual -79w|b|/500.
This excludes every finite nearby nontrivial motion, including
higher-order arcs; the b=0 equality case fixes all three factors.

5. The first-order observation is correctly subordinate to the
finite result. A canonical direction such as (1,0) has equal
endpoint supports and the midpoint row (-1/2,1,-1/2). The stated
fixed-mass implication and cap derivative follow. No general
shape, cap-motion or critical-maximal-depth assertion is hidden
in this linearized paragraph.

6. Threefold invariance forces all true fiber centroids to zero.
At the middle point, any nonvertical through-cap contains the
middle centroid and one endpoint centroid. Ordinary Grunbaum
therefore gives exactly the stated safe bound 233/756>2/9.
Vertical caps include whole fibers. Thus the scope warning is
correct: this is a radial variational obstruction above the
target, not a counterexample to the mixed depth bound.

The companion construction
`candidate 4e0a45efacd4af50`
preserves this local obstruction in a larger actual source and
separately certifies its exact global maximum. It does not change
the scope of the original one-group example.
